svg.title: The Medicare year: which window is open when
svg.desc: Open Enrollment runs October 15 to December 7. The Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period and the General Enrollment Period both run January 1 to March 31.

text.style: font:700 30px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d

svg.text: The Medicare year: which window is open when

text.style: font:400 18px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#4a5568

svg.text: These windows repeat every year. Outside them, you usually cannot change your coverage.
